mendelssohn_pilot_paradox_resolution._description: Resolves Phase 05.1 N=17 cross-subject ρ=-0.022 paradox via per-region ceiling-saturation separation
mendelssohn_pilot_paradox_resolution.interpretation: BOLD amygdala IS stimulus-driven cross-subject on full scan (ceiling +0.383, p<0.001). MI's amygdala-channel encoder fidelity on the Mendelssohn 80-TR subwindow is a separable question (ceiling itself is only +0.012 on this piece-specific window — Mendelssohn Op.54 technical, not emotion-loaded). Phase 05.1 negative ρ result was about MI encoder fidelity on the Mendelssohn-specific subwindow, NOT about general BOLD amygdala reliability.

tolerance._note: If local reproduction deviates beyond tolerance, L9 reconciles as CAVEAT (not FAIL); diagnostic dump required. n_pass_min thresholds = paper headline - 2 (small tolerance for stochastic CI variation).
